content.text:
Here are some **free online auto repair estimate** options:

1. **RepairPal Estimator** — good for common mechanical repairs like brakes, alternator, starter, radiator, oil leaks, etc. It gives price ranges based on ZIP code, vehicle, parts, and labor data. ([repairpal.com](https://repairpal.com/estimator/repair-services?utm_source=openai))

2. **YourMechanic Estimates** — free instant repair estimates and online booking for mobile mechanic services in many areas. ([yourmechanic.com](https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates/?utm_source=openai))

3. **Instant Estimator** — better for **auto body / collision repair** estimates; lets you get free estimates and may allow photo submissions. ([instantestimator.com](https://www.instantestimator.com/?utm_source=openai))

4. **CarAid** — offers repair estimates from photos, with AI plus human review; useful for body damage or visible issues. ([caraid.us](https://www.caraid.us/?utm_source=openai))

5. **VTCCO** — free AI-based collision/body repair estimate from uploaded vehicle damage photos. ([vtcco.com](https://vtcco.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Tip:** Use these as a ballpark only. Final shop prices can vary a lot depending on your ZIP code, labor rate, OEM vs. aftermarket parts, hidden damage, rust, diagnostics, and taxes.

If you want, send me your **year/make/model**, **ZIP code**, and the **repair needed**, and I can help you estimate a realistic price range.
